standard.coverage: Covered employers under this state's own act, which adopts or matches the federal rate.
standard.note: North Carolina sets its own rate equal to the federal $7.25 (N.C.G.S. 95-25.3).

tippedEmployeeThreshold.note: North Carolina's own threshold is more than $20 a month in tips, not the federal $30.

youthAndTraining.label: Federal youth opportunity wage
youthAndTraining.eligibility: Employees under 20, first 90 consecutive calendar days -- 29 U.S.C. 206(g). Not a state figure; carried here because it is the only sub-minimum wage available in this state.

indexation.note: Not indexed; moves only if the legislature (or Congress) moves it.
